Hi Hoto,

If I say to you that you are not very far from the reasoning, what would you say? By waiting and since you know my trades are based on engulfing, this was the engulfing I was looking for.

The green zone on my chart is Supply coming from Daily, weekly or monthly levels. So this PA was very logical in a very logical place.

Next u went to the m15 chart, perfect, I went to m5 but I did not touch trade it, so it was not perfect. I waited for selling to be visible on m5 and I entered.

Simply put, this was the only reasoning I have for this trade.

Good luck and I hope this makes a bit of sense.
